data_design: Public licensed non-Emoji animated movie frames. Whole film/cast assigned to exactly one role before extraction/scoring. Visual identity review and perceptual dedup before freezing; no legacy test images reused. Correlated frames are not independent identities.

negative_selection.random: uniform fixed-seed within same source quotas as mined
negative_selection.mined: rank by actual frozen V3 acceptance margin; 80% deepest accepted then remaining nearest-boundary/semi-hard; source quota and minimum timestamp spacing2s; no val/test inference

training.reason: identical steps for B/C, independent best-validation checkpoint per run
training.oe_objective: same V3 squared hinge energy margins T1; m_in initial ID-train90th quantile; m_out=m_in+2
training.augmentation: same V3 resize128,float32RGB/255; flip,rotation8,color jitter .12/.12/.1; no architecture/projection/SupCon/Triplet/backbone changes
training.checkpoint_selection: V3 validation-only quick OR at99% ID quantiles; feasible >=95% ID TAR and ID closed acc within3pp initial; minimize worst validation domain FAR then mean FAR then end-to-end ID acc; train full12 epochs even after best

calibration: Same ID73+Easy150+oldHard70+all reviewed new cartoon val for every B/C. Fit Gaussian only345 IDtrain; LedoitWolf raw/L2, T .5/1/2/5, distance/energy/OR/AND, >=95% ID TAR; minimize worst validation domain FAR then pooled FAR then correctID, simplicity. No test feature access. A uses immutable deployed detector.
evaluation: Only after all6 checkpoint/calibration hashes locked: same ID73,Easy150,permanentEmoji321,new frozen real-cartoon test. Report per-source/category and grouped bootstrap by movie/identity, separately across-seed SD.
promotion_gate: C must improve real-cartoon FAR and Emoji FAR versus A and B, group-bootstrap paired95% improvement CI excludes0, ID end-to-end drop<=3pp, ID FRR rise<=3pp,Easy FAR rise<=3pp; few independent final identities/sources can make gate inconclusive. No export or production change absent credible improvement.
limitations_predeclared: Single studio animated movie frames do not cover2D memes,plush toys or all character identities.
Temporal frames correlated; whole-source split prevents same-character leakage but small source count limits generalization and confidence intervals.
Visual review is by assistant contact-sheet inspection; no external human annotation or legal opinion.
